# P37.21 — Access closures and degree-only facts (row 445)

`implement-spec spec=docs/tickets/445_P37.21__access-closures-and-degree-only-facts.md live_verification=false`
Base: `r11/P37.20-release-pinned-bbox-api` · gate: none (answered decisions carried
verbatim — `D-K2-2 [A-11] = a (descriptive only) · D-K2-3 [B-22] = as recommended`)
· OM-20: no · production mutations: none (`exports/`, `inference/`, `web/` code and
tests; export artifacts ship with the next release).

## Requirement stamps

- **SIG-UI-025** (access-path closures with hop lists and per-hop evidence),
  **SIG-RECON-048/049/050** (bounded, labelled closure: scope never broadens, every
  hop evidenced, ≤ 3 hops publishable, speculative beyond, path-minimum
  confidence), **SIG-UI-080** (withheld-organisations notice — a withheld hop
  drops the whole path, never named or counted), **SIG-UI-117 / SIG-INGEST-043c /
  D-K2-3** (degree-only facts as node-attribute sentences, never edges),
  **SIG-UI-116/088** (historical and undated marked), **SIG-ONTO-042/044** (access
  kinds kept separate; a single snapshot never proves a start),
  **SIG-EXPORT-014** (per-compartment emission; a path files only where every
  hop's evidence licenses — ADR-106), **SIG-UI-122** (per-hop evidence reaches
  `#claim-` provenance in one action), **SIG-UI-053/108** (no raw identifier as
  a label — the emitted `rationale`/ids stay in the JSON twin; the page renders
  the shared label or a typed review state).
- Cited: **D-K2-2 [A-11] = a** carried verbatim — descriptive views only; no
  centrality, rankings or labelled communities. **D-K2-3 [B-22] = as
  recommended** — node attribute sentences only (SIG-INGEST-043c). No owned
  §56 `Owner:` ids.

## What landed

- `inference/src/inference/access_paths.py` —
  `access_edges_from_materialized` now carries the materialized row's
  `valid_to` + bound-kind vocabulary translated onto the closure's
  (`exact`/`before`/`after`/`known` → `known`; `ongoing`/`never` → `ongoing`;
  else `unknown`) and the full `evidence_claims` set, so a recorded end marks
  the hop expired and the path historical (the live-vs-historical input).
- `exports/src/exports/entity_page.py` — `closure_edge_pools` (outbound +
  reversed inbound pools), `access_closures` (per-entity build-time closure in
  both directions via the consumed `close_access_paths`; multi-hop only; full
  hop lists; per-hop evidence + labelled party views; counts
  publishable/historical/speculative; withheld hops drop the path into
  `withheld_notice`), `_closure_for_compartment` (all-hops-evidence filing,
  re-counts, 100-path cap with true `path_count`/`more`),
  `degree_only_facts.sentences` (D-K2-3 verbatim), `build_twin`/`artifacts`
  wiring incl. the absent-`as_of` typed-empty guard.
- `web/src/lib/entity-page.ts` — `AccessClosure{Hop,Path,Group}` +
  `DegreeOnlyFact.sentences` + fixture twin.
- `web/src/lib/entity-pages.ts` — `mergeEntityTwins` unions the closure groups
  across compartments (dedupe on the hop chain; counts re-derived; `more` a
  conservative max).
- `web/src/pages/entity/[type]/[key]/index.astro` — the Access section renders
  both question groups, the labelled hop chain, temporal/speculative marks and
  `#claim-` evidence links — SSR only; the page stays T1.
